Attached is our onboarding packet (SparrowTech_Onboarding_Form.pdf) and I'll route W9 to you by EOD. If you need any additional fields on the PO (billing contact, tax id), let me know.

  * Professional Services (onboarding/paygo) — SKU: SPT-IMPL-PAYGO-002 — $10,000
  * Hosting (month 1) — SKU: SPT-HOST-001 — $25,000 (moved some of the estimated first-phase spend here)

One caveat — final PO conversion to a permanent RNW PO requires completed W9 + signed SOW + legal approval of payment terms. Please prioritize W9 upload to procurement@sparrowtech.com and share the DocuSign link for SOW when available.
